scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof valid for every prime p>=5; standalone complete finite checks for 5,7,11,13,19 supplement but do not replace proof. Best-knowledge originality; independent examination not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete ordered two-sum representation spectrum of the standard modular inverse graph modulo odd prime squares, and the resulting constant-input averaged Kloosterman fourth moment. No unrestricted sharp Fourier-extension norm is claimed. Higher powers and p=2,3 not covered. An unlocated equivalent Kloosterman-moment result may exist.
title: Four-valued nonzero convolution fibers of the prime-square modular hyperbola
